name: pf-mod-freeskills
about: mod-freeskills against the built package qol instead of the mods' source folders (tools/make_package_scenarios.py). Issue #78, mods/freeskills: a respec at the Skill Trainer (class swap SkillTrainerContent -> HWPSkillTrainerContent) unlearns the skills the class starts with too (the Paladin's Blessed Strikes and its passive pal_armor, starting-level 1), saved as pick -1 = level 0; the trainer sells each back for 0 points and the free points don't move. The negative pick survives a save and load (PlayerRecordLoad hook; vanilla's Load clamps it to 0). Off: the vanilla respec, starting skills learned again.

steps.pattern: \[HWP:freeskills\] free skills on; pal_blessed_strikes 0/1, pal_armor 0/1; \d+ point\(s\) free, 0 spent
steps.name: a fresh Paladin: both starting skills learned (pick 0, level 1), none bought
buy Lay on Hands 1 in the swapped trainer window

steps.pattern: \[HWP:freeskills\] free skills on; pal_blessed_strikes 0/1, pal_armor 0/1; \d+ point\(s\) free, [1-9]\d* spent
steps.name: Lay on Hands bought: points spent

steps.pattern: \[HWP:freeskills\] respec: 2 starting skill\(s\) unlearned: pal_blessed_strikes \(-1\), pal_armor \(-1\); \d+ point\(s\) free
steps.name: the respec unlearns both starting skills (pick -1)
the trainer sells Blessed Strikes 1 for 0

steps.pattern: \[HWP:freeskills\] free skills on; pal_blessed_strikes -1/0, pal_armor -1/0; \d+ point\(s\) free, 0 spent
steps.name: after the respec: both at level 0, nothing spent

steps.pattern: respec: 2 starting skill\(s\) unlearned: [^\r\n]*; (\d+) point\(s\) free[\s\S]*\[HWP:freeskills\] learned pal_blessed_strikes level 1 for free, \1 point\(s\) free
steps.name: Blessed Strikes 1 learned for free: the free points are what the respec left

steps.pattern: \[HWP:freeskills\] free skills on; pal_blessed_strikes 0/1, pal_armor -1/0; \d+ point\(s\) free, 0 spent
steps.name: Blessed Strikes back at level 1, Armor (pal_armor) still unlearned

steps.pattern: \[HWP:freeskills\] free skills on; pal_blessed_strikes 0/1, pal_armor -1/0; \d+ point\(s\) free, 0 spent
steps.name: after a save and load: Armor (pal_armor) still unlearned (pick -1 kept)
after the load the trainer still sells Armor (pal_armor) 1 for 0

steps.pattern: \[HWP:freeskills\] free skills off; pal_blessed_strikes 0/1, pal_armor 0/1; \d+ point\(s\) free, 0 spent
steps.name: off: the vanilla respec, starting skills stay learned
